decision_precedence.condition: unresolved_sev1 == 0 and unresolved_sev2 == 0 and substantive_evidence_sufficient == true

amendment_rationale: RBM-005 v1.0.0 initial release. Six gates, each naming a failure mode observed in the domain rather than invented for symmetry with another profile.

chain_gates.name: Price observability
chain_gates.requirement: Every price must carry its source, its market, and the instant it was observed. A price without a timestamp is not evidence, because the whole claim depends on both legs being available at once.
chain_gates.failure_mode: An arb is computed from prices read minutes apart. It existed for neither of them together.

chain_gates.name: Market identity and settlement
chain_gates.requirement: Both legs must be shown to settle under identical rules, quoted verbatim from each operator. Rules are never normalised, paraphrased, or assumed equivalent because the market names match.
chain_gates.failure_mode: Two books offer 'Team A to win'. One voids on abandonment and the other pays; one settles at 90 minutes and the other includes extra time. Both legs priced correctly and the lock is a coin flip.

chain_gates.name: Executability at size
chain_gates.requirement: The stated odds must be shown available at the stake the arb requires. Exchange sizes are observed from the book; bookmaker limits are an upper bound applied per account and must be labelled as such.
chain_gates.failure_mode: A headline price is available for five pounds. The arb is real and worth nothing.

chain_gates.name: Account and limit reality
chain_gates.requirement: Account status, stake restrictions and prior limitations must be recorded. An arb requiring a stake the account cannot place is UNFILLABLE, never profit.
chain_gates.failure_mode: The account has been restricted to a fraction of the advertised maximum, and every calculation assumed the advertised one.

chain_gates.name: Counterparty and void exposure
chain_gates.requirement: The loss if one leg voids and the other loses must be computed and reported beside the guaranteed return. Palpable-error and void policies must be quoted from each operator.
chain_gates.failure_mode: A twenty-nine pound guaranteed return carries two hundred and fifty pounds of one-sided exposure, and only the twenty-nine appears on the screen.

chain_gates.name: Reproducibility
chain_gates.requirement: Every quoted price must be recorded with enough detail that a third party can state what was offered, where, and when. Commission treatment must be shown in the arithmetic rather than assumed.
chain_gates.failure_mode: A margin is reported gross of commission. At five per cent of net winnings a one per cent margin was never a margin.
